José Figueres Ferrer was the Costa Rican leader who won the civil war of 1948 and founded the country's Second Republic. He was president three times, in 1948 and 1949, 1953 to 1958, and 1970 to 1974.

A coffee and rope farmer, he was exiled in 1942 for attacking the government on the radio. In 1948 he led the rising that won the Costa Rican Civil War. His junta abolished the army, nationalised the banks, gave women the vote and made the Black people of Limón citizens.

In 1951 he founded the National Liberation Party, which dominated politics for decades with state companies and a welfare state. He opposed the dictators of the region, such as the Somozas. Like Morazán before him, he is a founder figure for Costa Rica.
sum: José Figueres Ferrer was the Costa Rican leader who won the civil war of 1948 and founded the country's Second Republic. He was president three times, in 1948 and 1949, 1953 to 1958, and 1970 to 1974.
